unit: QA harness spreadsheet schema and QA_ONLY marker
description: The isolated WF2 B1 harness spreadsheet carries Matters and Actions headers identical to production plus a QA_MARKER tab whose cell A2 is the write-permission token.
why_it_exists: Copying production node code byte-for-byte only proves anything if the target sheet has the production column layout; and every downstream write gate keys off QA_MARKER!A2, so the marker's exact cell and exact string are load-bearing.

QA_MARKER.A4: Isolated harness for WF2 B1. Synthetic data only. Never a production register.

assertions: Matters header equals the 14-column production order exactly, ending in unmapped_facts_json.
Actions header equals the 18-column production order exactly, ending in updated_at.
QA_MARKER!A2 is exactly the string QA_ONLY_DO_NOT_WRITE_PRODUCTION - no whitespace, no case variation.
Headers are written with valueInputOption RAW so no value is coerced by Sheets.
All three ranges are read back and compared after writing; a write that reports success but reads back wrong fails the run.
target_unresolved_reason: kind is "schema": not executed by harness/run.js.
